description:
Slippi Nintendont (Wii): Live Melee game data over TCP 51441.
Install Nintendont + Slippi on the Wii, enable the Slippi network feed, then connect S.M.A.R.T. to the Wii IP:51441.
Optional: connect through a Slippi relay (often port 53741+).

PROS:
- Direct Wii / relay TCP (no Dolphin, no GPU/CPU on the SMART machine)
- Native Python parser (no Node sidecar)
- Rollback-safe stock and winner reporting
- Supports Singles and limited Doubles

CONS:
- Wii nametags often lack Slippi Online display names
- Console feed has no rollback; offline finalization is used
